What hardware do I need to mine ERG?
Any modern GPU with 4GB+ VRAM can mine ERG efficiently. AMD and NVIDIA cards both work well. Popular choices include RTX 3070, RTX 4070, and RX 6800.
Which mining software should I use?
lolMiner and T-Rex are the most popular options for ERG mining. Both are free (with dev fee) and support Windows and Linux.
What is the current block reward?
The current block reward is dynamically adjusted. Check the network stats above for the latest reward amount.
For most miners, pool mining is more consistent. Solo mining requires significant hashrate to find blocks regularly.
Is Ergo still profitable to mine?

Profitability depends on your electricity costs, hardware efficiency, and current network difficulty. Use a mining calculator to estimate earnings. Many miners find Ergo profitable due to lower competition compared to major coins.

Ergo uses the Autolykos algorithm specifically designed to be ASIC-resistant through memory-hard computations. The algorithm can be updated if ASICs threaten decentralization. The community is committed to keeping mining accessible to GPU miners.
How stable is the Ergo development team?

Ergo has a strong, active development team led by experienced cryptographers and blockchain researchers. The project is open-source with regular updates and a clear roadmap. Check the GitHub activity and join Discord to see the active community.
How does storage rent affect miners?

Storage rent is a unique mechanism that provides miners with income beyond block rewards. When emissions end, miners will continue earning from storage rent collected from dormant boxes. This ensures long-term network security and miner profitability.
